import unittest
from reports.export import export_csv

class TestExport(unittest.TestCase):

    def test_export_csv(self):
        rows = [{'a': 1, 'b': 2}, {'a': 3, 'b': 4}]
        columns = ['a', 'b']
        expected = 'a,b\\r\\n1,2\\r\\n3,4\\r\\n'
        self.assertEqual(export_csv(rows, columns), expected)

    def test_export_csv_empty(self):
        rows = []
        columns = ['a', 'b']
        expected = 'a,b\\r\\n'
        self.assertEqual(export_csv(rows, columns), expected)

    def test_export_csv_missing_field(self):
        rows = [{'a': 1}]
        columns = ['a', 'b']
        expected = 'a,b\\r\\n1,'
        self.assertEqual(export_csv(rows, columns), expected)

    def test_export_csv_none_field(self):
        rows = [{'a': None, 'b': 2}]
        columns = ['a', 'b']
        expected = 'a,b\\r\\n,,2\\r\\n'
        self.assertEqual(export_csv(rows, columns), expected)

    def test_export_csv_duplicate_column(self):
        with self.assertRaises(ValueError):
            export_csv([{'a': 1, 'b': 2}], ['a', 'a'])

if __name__ == '__main__':
    unittest.main()
